ques: Search for the latest preprints about 'quantum computing'.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include an on-site arXiv search whose URL carries both query tokens (quantum and computing). (2) The final answer MUST name at least one real quantum-computing preprint that the mirror's own search returns (paper title or arXiv id). (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: no on-site quantum-computing search; the answer names no paper from the search results.

ques: Search for the latest research papers on quantum computing submitted to ArXiv within the last two days.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include an on-site search for quantum computing restricted to the last two days (URL carries last_days=2 or explicit date bounds). (2) The final answer MUST list at least two distinct papers from the mirror's two-day result set. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: no two-day-windowed search; fewer than two result papers are reported.

ques: Look up the most recent papers related to 'cs.CL', select one and show its abstract.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST reach the cs.CL listing (or a cs.CL search) and/or the abstract page of one of the newest cs.CL papers. (2) The final answer MUST identify one of the most recent cs.CL papers (title or arXiv id) AND show that paper's abstract as the mirror serves it (a verbatim leading portion or its distinctive wording). (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the paper named is not among the newest cs.CL papers; the abstract shown belongs to a different paper.

ques: Locate the most recent research paper about 'Algebraic Topology' under Mathematics published on ArXiv. Provide the title of the paper, the name of the authors, and the abstract.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the Algebraic Topology (math.AT) listing under Mathematics, a search that surfaces math.AT papers, or the chosen paper's /abs page. (2) The final answer MUST give the title of a math.AT paper, its author names, and its abstract as shown on the mirror. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the paper is not an Algebraic Topology (math.AT) paper; authors or abstract are missing or belong to another paper.

ques: Find the most recent research papers in Astrophysics of Galaxies. How many papers have been announced in the last day?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the Astrophysics of Galaxies (astro-ph.GA) listing or an equivalent galaxies search. (2) The final answer MUST state how many papers were announced on the most recent announce day (the mirror's 'last day'), or name that day's paper. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: no astro-ph.GA page was opened; the announced-paper count/name is wrong.

ques: Search papers about "quantum computing" which has been submitted to the Quantum Physics category on ArXiv. How many results in total. What if search in all archives?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include an on-site search for quantum computing filtered to the Quantum Physics category (category=quant-ph appears in a visited search URL). (2) The final answer MUST report the total number of results for the Quantum Physics category AND the total when searching all archives. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the category-filtered search is missing; either total is missing or wrong.

ques: How many figures and tables are in the paper "On the Sentence Embeddings from Pre-trained Language Models"?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the abstract page (or PDF) of the paper 'On the Sentence Embeddings from Pre-trained Language Models', or a title search that surfaces it. (2) The final answer MUST report the number of figures and the number of tables shown in that paper's Comments field. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the paper page/search is missing; either count is missing or wrong.

ques: Find the most recent paper submitted on machine learning in the Computer Science category posted on ArXiv.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include a machine-learning search restricted to the Computer Science category, or the cs.LG / cs new listing, or the chosen paper's /abs page. (2) The final answer MUST name the most recent machine-learning paper in the Computer Science category (title or arXiv id, as posted on the mirror's newest announce day). (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: no cs machine-learning page was opened; the named paper is not among the newest cs machine-learning papers.

ques: What is the latest news on ArXiv?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the arXiv News page (/news). (2) The final answer MUST describe the latest news item — the milestone about the total number of submissions. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the news page was not opened; the answer reports a blog post or an older news item instead of the latest news.

ques: Find the latest research paper about neural networks published on ArXiv which has been submitted within the last week.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include a neural-networks search (with the last-week window) or the chosen paper's /abs page. (2) The final answer MUST name the newest neural-networks paper submitted within the last week (title or arXiv id). (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the named paper is not the latest weekly neural-networks paper on the mirror.

ques: Visit ArXiv Help on how to withdraw an article if the submission is not yet announced.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the arXiv Help page about withdrawing an article. (2) The final answer MUST state how a not-yet-announced submission is withdrawn: from the user page and the Delete button (before the announcement deadline). (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the withdraw help page was not opened; the described procedure does not match it.

ques: For Non-English submissions, do I need to provide a multi-language abstract, if need, answer the separator between the multiple abstracts.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the arXiv Help page about Non-English submissions. (2) The final answer MUST state that a multi-language abstract is required and give the separator used between the multiple abstracts (two hyphens, '--'). (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the help page was not opened; the requirement or the separator is missing/wrong.

ques: Find store in arXiv Help, tell me how many styles of arXiv Logo Shirt are available?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST reach the arXiv store from the Help pages and open the arXiv Logo Shirt item (or the store page showing its styles). (2) The final answer MUST state how many styles of the arXiv Logo Shirt are available. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: neither the store nor its help entry was opened; the style count is wrong.

ques: How many articles on ArXiv with 'SimCSE' in the title?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include an on-site title search for SimCSE. (2) The final answer MUST state the number of articles with 'SimCSE' in the title (or list all of them). (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: no title search; the count is wrong.

ques: On ArXiv, how many articles have 'SimCSE' in the article and are originally announced in October 2023?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include an on-site SimCSE search restricted to October 2023 (year/month or date bounds in the URL), or open one of the October-2023 result pages. (2) The final answer MUST state how many articles have 'SimCSE' in the article and were originally announced in October 2023 (or list them). (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the October-2023 window is missing; the count is wrong.

ques: Searching Chinese Benchmark on ArXiv, how many papers announced in December 2023 mention being accepted for AAAI 2024?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include an on-site 'Chinese Benchmark' search restricted to December 2023. (2) The final answer MUST state how many of the returned papers mention being accepted for AAAI 2024 (or list those papers). (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the December-2023 window is missing; the AAAI-2024 count is wrong (the total result count alone is not the answer).

ques: Locate the latest research about gravitational waves that were uploaded to ArXiv this week and provide a brief summary of one article's main findings.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include a gravitational-waves search with the last-week window, or open one of this week's gravitational-wave paper pages. (2) The final answer MUST name one gravitational-wave paper uploaded this week AND summarize its main findings as stated on its abstract page. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the paper is not from this week's gravitational-wave results; the summary does not match the paper's abstract.

ques: Find the paper 'GPT-4 Technical Report', when was v3 submitted?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the abstract page of 'GPT-4 Technical Report'. (2) The final answer MUST state when v3 was submitted, per the submission history shown on that page. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the paper's abstract page was not opened; the v3 date is missing or wrong.

ques: Download the paper 'Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering'. How many formulas are in the article and which one is the loss function?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the abstract (or PDF) page of 'Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering'. (2) The final answer MUST state the number of formulas in the article and identify the loss function — the similarity-based (sim(q, p)) in-batch negative log-likelihood. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the paper page is missing; the formula count or the loss function is wrong.

ques: Which university maintains and manages ArXiv. Accessing the university's website from ArXiv, how many underegraduate students are currently at the university.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST identify the university that maintains and manages arXiv and open that university's page from arXiv. (2) The final answer MUST name the university AND state its current number of undergraduate students as shown on that page. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the university's page was not reached; the university or the undergraduate count is wrong.

ques: Find the latest paper on 'machine learning in the Statistics section of ArXiv and provide its abstract.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the Statistics section's Machine Learning area (the stat.ML listing, a Statistics-restricted search, or the newest paper's abstract page). (2) The final answer MUST name the latest machine-learning paper in the Statistics section (title or arXiv id) and provide its abstract. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the paper is not the newest Statistics-section machine-learning paper; the abstract is missing or belongs to another paper.

ques: Search for papers on 'neural networks for image processing' in the Computer Science category on ArXiv and report how many were submitted in the last week.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include an on-site search for 'neural networks for image processing' restricted to the Computer Science category and the last-week window. (2) The final answer MUST state how many papers were submitted in the last week (or list the matching papers). (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the category/week-windowed search is missing; the count is wrong.

ques: Locate the ArXiv Help section and find instructions on how to subscribe to daily listing emails for new submissions in a specific category.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the arXiv Help page about subscribing to daily listing emails. (2) The final answer MUST describe the subscription instructions shown there (using Alerts, the daily frequency, and the category). (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the subscribe help page was not opened; the described steps do not match it.

ques: Determine how many articles with the keyword 'autonomous vehicles' were published in the 'Electrical Engineering and Systems Science' section of ArXiv yesterday.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include an on-site 'autonomous vehicles' search in the Electrical Engineering and Systems Science section, with yesterday's date window (the mirror pins 'today'; all relative wording is relative to that date). (2) The final answer MUST state how many articles were published yesterday (or name them). (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: no eess autonomous-vehicles search; the count is wrong.

ques: Identify the most recent paper related to 'graph neural networks' on ArXiv and determine the affiliation of the first author.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include a graph-neural-networks search or the chosen paper's abstract page. (2) The final answer MUST identify the most recent paper related to graph neural networks (title or arXiv id). NOTE: the mirror renders author names only — no page shows author affiliations, so if the affiliation cannot be found, the graded core is the correct paper identification. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Browse the ArXiv store and let me know how many different types of merchandise are available.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the arXiv store page. (2) The final answer MUST state how many different types of merchandise are available — count the merchandise products the store page lists. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the store was not opened; the merchandise count is wrong.

ques: Search for papers related to 'climate change modeling' on ArXiv and find out how many have been published in the Earth and Planetary Astrophysics (astro-ph.EP) category in the last week.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include an on-site 'climate change modeling' search restricted to the astro-ph.EP category (with the last-week window, or listing the matching papers). (2) The final answer MUST state how many papers were published in that category in the last week (or list them). (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the astro-ph.EP restriction is missing; the count is wrong.

ques: On ArXiv, what categories does Economics include, and what are their abbreviations?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the Economics category page, the category taxonomy, or an Economics listing/search. (2) The final answer MUST list the subcategories Economics includes and their abbreviations. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: no Economics page was opened; subcategory names or abbreviations are missing/wrong.

ques: Search 'Poly encoder' by title on ArXiv and check whether the articles in the search results provide HTML access.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include an on-site search for 'Poly encoder' (the title search and/or the all-fields search). (2) The final answer MUST state whether the articles in the search results provide HTML access, as the mirror's result cards and abstract pages show. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: no Poly search was performed; the HTML-access statement is wrong or absent.

ques: On ArXiv, search for papers with 'Neural Network Optimization' in the title published in 2023, and provide the number of such papers.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include an on-site title search for 'Neural Network Optimization' restricted to 2023. (2) The final answer MUST state the number of such papers (or list them). (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the title search or the 2023 restriction is missing; the count is wrong.

ques: Look up the submission guidelines on ArXiv for submitting a paper and tell me the formats for figures.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the arXiv Help pages about submitting a paper / figure formats. (2) The final answer MUST list the accepted figure formats shown on the figure-formats help page (PDF, PNG, JPG/JPEG, EPS). (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: no help page was opened; the format list is wrong or incomplete.

ques: Search ArXiv for papers with 'Graph Neural Networks' in the abstract that were submitted between Jan 1, 2024, and Jan 3, 2024, and determine how many of these papers have more than five authors.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include an on-site abstract-field search for 'Graph Neural Networks' restricted to 2024-01-01..2024-01-03. (2) The final answer MUST state how many of these papers have more than five authors (the result cards display author counts). (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the date window is missing; the more-than-five-authors count is wrong (the total result count alone is not the answer).

ques: Locate the latest paper on ArXiv within the 'Nonlinear Sciences - Chaotic Dynamics' category, summarize the abstract and note the submission date.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the Nonlinear Sciences - Chaotic Dynamics (nlin.CD) listing or the chosen paper's abstract page. (2) The final answer MUST name the latest nlin.CD paper, summarize the abstract as the mirror serves it, and note the submission date. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the paper is not the latest nlin.CD paper; the date or the abstract summary is missing/wrong.

ques: Query ArXiv for the latest research article in the category of Systems and Control under Computer Science. Summarize the main objective or hypothesis presented in the paper and provide the names of the authors.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the Systems and Control (cs.SY) listing or the chosen article's abstract page. (2) The final answer MUST name the latest Systems-and-Control article, give its author names, and summarize the main objective or hypothesis presented in the paper. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the article is not the latest; authors or the objective/hypothesis are missing or wrong.

ques: Search for the most recent paper related to non-commutative geometry submitted by an author with the first name John. Provide the title and the abstract.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include an on-site non-commutative-geometry search (checking authors for the first name John), or open the candidate paper's abstract page. (2) The final answer MUST name the most recent non-commutative-geometry paper submitted by an author with the first name John and give its abstract. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the paper is not a non-commutative-geometry paper by a John-first-named author; the abstract is missing or wrong.

ques: Retrieve the latest research paper in Quantum Physics from ArXiv and provide the title, author(s), and date of submission.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the Quantum Physics (quant-ph) listing or the chosen paper's abstract page. (2) The final answer MUST give the latest quant-ph paper's title, author(s), and date of submission as shown on the mirror. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the paper is not the latest quant-ph paper; title, authors, or date are missing/wrong.

ques: Search 'CVPR 2023' and 'CVPR2023' through journal ref on ArXiv to see how many results there are respectively.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include two on-site journal-ref searches: 'CVPR 2023' and 'CVPR2023' (the advanced search offers the Journal-ref field). (2) The final answer MUST state how many results each search returns. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: either journal-ref search is missing; either count is wrong.

ques: Find the names of people in ArXiv's Leadership Team.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the About page. (2) The final answer MUST list the names of the people in arXiv's Leadership Team — all of them as shown on the About page. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the About page was not opened; leadership names are missing or wrong.

ques: Find the ArXiv Blog on the ArXiv website and summarize the content of its latest article.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the arXiv Blog (index or the latest post). (2) The final answer MUST summarize the content of the latest blog article — the open-access-themed post. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the blog was not opened; the summary is about an older post or about the news page instead.

ques: Search the title 'GPT-4 Technical Report' and access this paper through HTML format. Read the paper on this page and tell me what is 'one of the main goals of developing such models' mentioned in the Introduction.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the paper 'GPT-4 Technical Report' through its HTML format page. (2) The final answer MUST state what the Introduction gives as 'one of the main goals of developing such models'. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the HTML page was not opened; the quoted goal does not match the Introduction.

ques: How many articles are there on each of the three most recent announce days in the Solar and Stellar Astrophysics section of ArXiv. Choose one at random and answer its title and when the first version was uploaded?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the Solar and Stellar Astrophysics (astro-ph.SR) listing. (2) The final answer MUST state how many articles appear on each of the three most recent announce days, and for one chosen paper give its title and when the first version was uploaded. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the day counts are wrong/missing; no chosen paper with its first-version date is reported.

ques: Find the button to share arxiv non-profit store and follow the QR code to share the shop. Then add arXiv Forever short sleeve (XL) to your cart.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the arXiv Forever Short Sleeve store item page. (2) The final answer MUST report the XL add-to-cart action (selecting the XL style and adding it to the cart). NOTE: the mirror has no share button or QR code on the store, and Add to Cart shows only a confirmation alert, so the verifiable core is the item page plus the XL cart action. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Find an article published between 1 January 2000 and 1 January 2005 that requires Support Vector Machines in the title and its Journey ref is ACL Workshop.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST include an on-site search for Support Vector Machines papers (title field) within 1 January 2000..1 January 2005, or open a qualifying article's abstract page. (2) The final answer MUST identify an article with Support Vector Machines in the title whose journal reference is an ACL Workshop. (3) An empty answer is a FAIL. FAIL if: the article does not match all constraints; the journal reference is missing/wrong.
